verdict.rationale: Luma documents text-to-video generation, which hands-on community users confirm works, though output quality is mixed. Draft Mode, Modify Video V2 (reshaping existing footage) and agents that 'generate and refine' support iterating on a result. However, the docs never explicitly say a creator can take a previously generated clip and refine, extend or re-prompt it rather than regenerating. The 'extend a prior video' item appears only as an FAQ question, so it is not affirmative support. missing for 10: explicit documentation of iterating on or extending a prior generation (versioning or re-prompting a generated clip), and independent hands-on corroboration of the iteration workflow.

support.subject: As a creator, I can turn a text prompt into a video clip and iterate on the result without starting from scratch each time
